skillFull: Hop, skips and jumps forward at certain intervals. With each jump, the Hydrangea Jelly on its back falls off, returning a certain amount of jumps later. Violet Hydrangea Jellies recovers Energy. Level Up for more points for Hydrangea Jellies and more Energy recovery from Violet Hydrangea Jellies.
story: This flowery frog carries a hydrangea that was perpetually graced with the moisture it needs to grow! But have you tried hopping less? After all, the hopping and skipping might hurt the flower! Alas, this rascal never seems to listen to instructions. If a frog can hop, then it will indeed hop! Let's just hope all that skipping and hopping doesn't ruin the flower!

costumes.name: Flowered UP!
costumes.info: Cookies from the Lotus Palace are going on a picnic! "If you behave yourself, you can come too, Floral Froglet!" Oh boy, oh boy indeed! Look at how this Pet has dressed up for this excursion!

costumes.name: Starshine Garden Hopper
costumes.info: Don't be surprised if you see something green whiz past you in the Starshine Garden! It's just Floral Froglet hopping around. Maybe the ambitious Pet wanted more than star-shaped flowers. Could this adorable critter make its leap for the stars in the night sky?
